## Flagship Software Products

### 1. Argun Billing Software
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/billing-software.html
- **Product Category**: GST Invoicing, Retail Point of Sale (POS), Wholesale Inventory, and Khata Management Software.
- **Operating Platforms**: Web Cloud Application, Offline Local Mode, Multi-Device Sync.
- **Target Sectors**: Kirana stores, plywood & timber merchants, hardware stores, pharmacy & medical shops, wholesale distributors, cloth & textile merchants.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Lightning-fast GST tax invoice creation with HSN/SAC code autofill.
  - Barcode label generation and instant thermal receipt printing.
  - Batch number and expiry date tracking with automatic low-stock notifications.
  - Customer credit ledger (Khata Book) with automated WhatsApp payment reminder alerts.
  - Chartered Accountant (CA) verified GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B tax return export tables.
  - Seamless offline functionality with automatic cloud sync upon internet reconnection.

### 2. Argun Garage Management Software (ArgunGMS)
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/garage-management-software.html
- **Product Category**: Automobile Workshop, Multi-Brand Service Center, and Cashless Insurance Bodyshop Management Software.
- **Operating Platforms**: Cloud-Based SaaS, Mobile Web, Tablet Optimized.
- **Target Sectors**: 2-wheeler & 4-wheeler repair garages, car detailing studios, multi-brand auto service workshops, cashless insurance accident repair centers.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Digital inward vehicle job cards capturing odometer readings, fuel levels, vehicle photos, and customer complaints.
  - Spare parts inventory tracking with part numbers, minimum stock thresholds, and purchase orders.
  - Insurer pre-invoicing, surveyor estimation approvals, and cashless insurance claim settlement records.
  - Automated WhatsApp job card status and vehicle delivery alerts for vehicle owners.
  - Technician work allocation and mechanic commission tracking.

### 3. Argun Loan Management System (ArgunLMS)
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/loan-management-system.html
- **Product Category**: Lending CRM, Micro-Finance Institution (MFI), Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), and Cooperative Credit Society Software.
- **Operating Platforms**: Cloud Infrastructure, Multi-Branch Secure Database.
- **Target Sectors**: Money lenders, private finance firms, self-help groups (SHG), micro-credit organizations, and vehicle/equipment financiers.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Comprehensive borrower KYC document archiving, guarantor profiles, and credit risk evaluation.
  - Flexible repayment configurations: Daily, Weekly, Fortnightly, and Monthly EMI schedules.
  - Automated interest calculations (Flat Rate, Reducing Balance, and Penalty on Late Installments).
  - Field collection agent route planning, mobile cash settlement receipts, and real-time ledger sync.
  - Non-Performing Asset (NPA) and defaulter tracking with automated overdue SMS alerts.

### 4. Argun CA Firm Management System
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/ca-firm-management-system.html
- **Product Category**: Chartered Accountant Practice ERP, Tax Consultant Workflow, and Audit Document Management System.
- **Operating Platforms**: Secure Encrypted Web Cloud.
- **Target Sectors**: Chartered Accountants (CA), Tax Practitioners, Company Secretaries (CS), and Accounting Advisory Firms.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Centralized client database storing GSTIN, PAN, TAN, Digital Signature (DSC) expiry, and MCA details.
  - WhatsApp integrated client document collection portal for monthly bills, bank statements, and TDS certificates.
  - Article clerk task allocation, timesheets, and milestone monitoring.
  - Dynamic statutory compliance calendar (GST, Income Tax, ROC, TDS, Advance Tax) with deadline notifications.
  - Professional fee invoicing, out-of-pocket expense tracking, and client ledger statements.

## Professional IT & Digital Services
- **Custom Web Engineering**: High-performance, SEO-optimized business websites for hospitals, schools, colleges, manufacturers, and corporate brands (Built using clean HTML5/CSS3, React, Next.js, and high-speed cloud hosting).
- **Local SEO & Google Business Profile Management**: Map ranking optimization, local citation building, and review schema integration for Tier-2 and Tier-3 commercial markets.
- **Mobile Application Development**: Native and cross-platform Android/iOS applications for field operations, delivery tracking, and client self-service.
- **AI & Automation Tools**: Workflow bots, customer query automation, and intelligent inventory prediction tools.

## Why Choose Argun Software Over Generic Alternatives
- **On-Ground Technical Support**: Direct on-site setup, training, and troubleshooting by engineers physically present in North Bihar and Eastern UP.
- **Built for Regional Indian Businesses**: Fully customized for local workflows (e.g., kacha/pakka billing, customer udhar tracking, mandi transactions, Hindi/English bilingual interfaces).
- **100% Tax Compliant**: Formatted to latest GSTN and Indian taxation mandates.
- **Zero Internet Lockout**: Crucial operations continue without interruption during local internet outages.
